description: This file contains a script for refactoring naming series in an ERP system, including updating property setters and preserving existing series options for various document types.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that updates property setters and sets new naming series options based on document types.

methods.name: set_series
methods.description: Sets the options and default value for the naming_series property of a given doctype.

methods.name: get_series
methods.description: Generates a mapping of doctypes to their preserved series options and default series.

methods.name: get_series_to_preserve
methods.description: Retrieves a sorted list of existing naming_series values for a given doctype.

methods.name: get_default_series
methods.description: Fetches the default naming series for a given doctype.
